methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page or Shopify App Store listing using WebFetch. Where the official page returned 403/JS-only/no prices, reputable third-party comparison sources (GetApp, Shopify App Store) were used and noted in provenance. accessedAt set to 2026-06-14 per dataset convention. monthlyUsd for annual-only plans is the annualized monthly rate; month-to-month rates noted where available. Open Loyalty publishes no self-serve prices (custom quote only based on monthly active members). Yotpo Loyalty official pricing page is JS-gated/returns no prices; GetApp used as primary source with note. LoyalZoo official site shows $77/mo for Grow plan; GetApp shows outdated $47/mo — official site used. Stamped.io official pricing page (website.stamped.io) returned 403; GetApp confirms starting at $19/mo but full tier data unavailable — Stamped included as quote-only. Talon.One: all plans custom/quote. ReferralHero annual discount: 3 months free (25% off effective annual rate).

vendors.name: Smile.io
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page smile.io/pricing fetched directly. Prices confirmed via Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/smile-io) and GetApp (getapp.com/customer-management-software/a/smile-io/pricing/). Plus plan is annual-only billing at $999/month.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 200 monthly orders. Points and referral programs, 15+ earning/redemption methods, multi-language support, Shopify POS.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Up to 500 monthly orders. Adds dedicated loyalty page, free product rewards, on-site nudges, analytics, Shopify Flow integration, 1 third-party integration. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Up to 1,000 monthly orders. Adds bonus point events, product page point display, subscription/gift card rewards, loyalty segments, ROI insights, 2 integrations. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Up to 2,500 monthly orders; $20 per additional 100 orders. Adds Loyalty Hub, VIP tiers, points expiry, 25+ pre-built reports, unlimited integrations. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Annual billing only ($11,988/yr). Up to 7,500 monthly orders; $5 per additional 100 orders. Adds white-glove migration, quarterly program monitoring, priority support, API access, 30+ specialized reports, SOC-2 compliance, preferred multi-store pricing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual billing only. Unlimited orders. Custom pricing — contact sales. Dedicated launch planning, data warehouse sync, 99.9% uptime SLA.

vendors.name: Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals
vendors.provenance: Official Yotpo pricing page (yotpo.com/pricing) is JavaScript-gated and returns no plan data when fetched. Pro confirmed at $199/mo (up to 500 orders) across GetApp and independent 2026 reviews. Premium corrected to $799/mo (up to 3,000 orders) per independent 2026 sources Rivo (rivo.io/blog/yotpo-loyalty-pricing) and ProPicked, which track the standalone Loyalty & Referrals product. The GetApp figure of $1,198/mo reflects Yotpo's bundled platform (Reviews + Loyalty + SMS + Email), not the standalone loyalty product this catalog tracks, and was not corroborated for Loyalty & Referrals alone.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Basic loyalty program features. Available via Shopify app store.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Up to 500 orders/month. Includes Reviews, Loyalty, SMS & Email in combined platform.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Up to 3,000 orders/month; $0.20 per additional order. Adds advanced segmentation, dedicated CSM, priority support, API access. Corrected from prior $1,198/mo (which reflected Yotpo's bundled Reviews+Loyalty+SMS+Email platform, not standalone Loyalty & Referrals).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 10,000+ included orders. Custom contract, dedicated enterprise account manager. Contact sales.

vendors.name: LoyaltyLion
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page loyaltylion.com/pricing fetched directly — Classic plan price confirmed at $199/mo; Advanced and Plus are quote-only. Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/loyaltylion) confirms Free plan up to 400 orders and Classic $199/mo. GetApp (getapp.com/customer-management-software/a/loyaltylion/) corroborates Classic at $199/mo.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 400 monthly orders (Shopify App Store listing). Points for activities, discount rewards, basic customization, analytics, 7 pre-written languages.

plans.name: Classic
plans.notes: 500 monthly orders included (25% grace buffer before plan review). Branded loyalty page, pre-built earning rules, unlimited integrations, Klaviyo flows, checkout redemption, onboarding support, optional VIP tiers. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Custom pricing — contact sales. Adds VIP tiers, product page points, enhanced Shopify POS, multilanguage support (130 languages), performance reviews. Volume-based pricing via interactive calculator on pricing page.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Custom pricing — contact sales. Adds AI-recommended rewards, advanced Klaviyo events, automated flows with conditional logic, strategic optimization. Volume-based pricing.

vendors.name: Stamped
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page stamped.io/pricing redirects to website.stamped.io/pricing which returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on both fetch attempts. GetApp (getapp.com/customer-management-software/a/stamped-io/pricing/) confirms starting price of $19/month flat rate but does not list full tier structure. Stamped's loyalty module is a paid add-on to their reviews platform; full tier pricing is not publicly accessible without authentication.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Basic reviews collection. Free version confirmed by GetApp listing.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Starting price per GetApp; official pricing page inaccessible (403). Full tier breakdown and loyalty add-on pricing require vendor contact or authenticated access.

plans.name: Professional / Enterprise
plans.notes: Higher tiers and loyalty module pricing not publicly disclosed. Official pricing page (website.stamped.io/pricing) returned 403 Forbidden. Contact sales for current tier pricing.

vendors.name: Open Loyalty
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page openloyalty.io/pricing fetched directly. Page explicitly states 'Let us estimate the pricing for your project' with no published self-serve tiers. Pricing is a combination of Platform Fee and Allowance Fee based on monthly Active Members. All pricing is custom quote only.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Pricing based on monthly Active Members (those performing at least one loyalty event per calendar month). Combination of Platform Fee + Allowance Fee. No self-serve tiers published. Book a demo to get estimate.

vendors.name: ReferralHero
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page referralhero.com/pricing fetched directly on two attempts — prices confirmed: Free $0, PRO $199/mo, PREMIUM $399/mo. Annual option: 3 months free with annual prepay (25% effective discount). Enterprise is custom. Note: GetApp lists different tiers ($249/$399) which appear outdated relative to the official page.

plans.name: Free Forever
plans.notes: Up to 25 members. All PRO features included. ReferralHero branding on widgets.

plans.name: PRO
plans.notes: Up to 10,000 members. Custom branding, analytics, FB Pixel, anti-fraud, coupon codes, unlimited campaigns, referral links, automation emails, custom sender domain, API, webhooks. Annual plan: 3 months free (effective $149.25/mo, paid as $1,792/yr). SMS billed separately pay-as-you-go.

plans.name: PREMIUM
plans.notes: Up to 50,000 members. All PRO features plus ReCaptcha, SMS Verification, priority support, broadcasts. Annual plan: 3 months free (effective $299.25/mo, paid as $3,591/yr).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Bespoke enterprise packages. Contact sales.

vendors.name: LoyalZoo
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page loyalzoo.com/pricing fetched directly — GROW plan confirmed at $77/month. SMART plan price was truncated/not rendered in fetch response. GetApp (getapp.com/customer-management-software/a/loyal-zoo/pricing/) shows outdated starting price of $47/month (official site takes precedence). SMART plan price recorded as null due to inability to confirm the exact figure.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Points or stamp-based loyalty, basic SMS/email/push marketing tools, subscriptions and memberships, automated recurring payments, 5,000 messaging credits included. 0-1% transaction fee on card-on-file payments. 7-day free trial.

plans.name: Smart
plans.notes: PRO PICK tier. Price not rendered on official pricing page fetch (content truncated). Contact vendor for current pricing.

vendors.name: Talon.One
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page talon.one/pricing fetched directly. Page explicitly states all pricing is individualized/custom — no published self-serve tiers. Volume-based on data/coupon usage (minimum 500,000 coupons for Starter). All three tiers (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) require sales contact.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Minimum 500,000 coupons threshold. Data-volume-based pricing. Ideal for high-growth companies. All pricing individualized — contact sales.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Most popular tier. Advanced deployments. Data-volume-based pricing. All pricing individualized — contact sales.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Large enterprise deployments. Data-volume-based pricing. All pricing individualized — contact sales.
